# UIL4B

> UIL4B is a browser-based workspace for building UI systems. Build colour systems, pair fonts, browse 200,000+ icons, convert images and video, generate accessible alt text, and export production-ready CSS and design tokens — all client-side. Every core tool is free forever, with 5 AI generations a day and 40 a month; Pro is from $4 USD a month and raises that to 30 a day and 300 a month, adds the advanced colour controls, and removes the export watermark. Free and Pro run the same AI model.

## Tools
- [Colour Palette Generator](https://www.uil4b.com/create/palette): Build palettes with harmony modes, tint scales, gradients, image extraction, named colour libraries, and CSS/Tailwind/PNG/SVG export.
- [Semantic Colour Generator](https://www.uil4b.com/create/semantic-color): Derive success, warning, error and information colours that hold their contrast in both themes.
- [Tint Scale Generator](https://www.uil4b.com/create/tint): Build perceptual tint and shade ramps from one seed colour.
- [Gradient Generator](https://www.uil4b.com/create/gradient): Design linear, radial and conic gradients with a live inspector and CSS output.
- [Contrast Checker](https://www.uil4b.com/create/contrast): Measure colour pairs against the WCAG thresholds and find the nearest passing fix.
- [Font Pair Finder](https://www.uil4b.com/create/font-pair): Discover and preview Google Font pairings for headings and body, with live samples and CSS import export.
- [Font Gallery](https://www.uil4b.com/create/font-gallery): Browse and compare the Google Fonts catalogue by category, weight, and style.
- [Type Scale Generator](https://www.uil4b.com/create/type-scale): Create modular type scales and export CSS/Tailwind/SCSS custom properties.
- [Icon Library](https://www.uil4b.com/create/icons): Search 200,000+ open-source icons and copy SVG or JSX instantly.
- [Emoji Library](https://www.uil4b.com/create/emoji): Search and copy emoji by category with skin-tone variants.
- [File Converter](https://www.uil4b.com/create/file-converter): Convert images (PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF), turn video into GIFs, and extract video frames — fully in-browser, nothing uploaded.
- [Aspect & Resolution Calculator](https://www.uil4b.com/create/aspect-ratio): Canonical ratio names with device and screen presets.
- [Alt Text Generator](https://www.uil4b.com/create/alt-text): Generate WCAG-compliant alt text for images with AI.
- [SEO Inspector](https://www.uil4b.com/seo): Check a page's title, meta, headings and structured data.

## Learn
Five published reference guides. Neutral and factual — design education, not documentation for these tools.

- [Learn](https://www.uil4b.com/learn): Index of the published guides and the topics still to come.
- [Colour contrast and the WCAG thresholds](https://www.uil4b.com/learn/colour-contrast): The thresholds, what counts as large text, how the ratio is calculated, non-text contrast, and what a ratio cannot see.
- [Modular type scales](https://www.uil4b.com/learn/type-scales): The formula, choosing a ratio, how the ratio compounds, joining two scales with clamp(), and line length.
- [Colour spaces for interface work](https://www.uil4b.com/learn/colour-spaces): Why HSL lightness is not lightness, what OKLCH measures instead, and gamut limits.
- [Dark and light themes](https://www.uil4b.com/learn/theme-systems): One set of names and two sets of values; why inversion is not a theme; what prefers-color-scheme, prefers-contrast, forced-colors and color-scheme each decide.
- [Choosing a brand colour](https://www.uil4b.com/learn/brand-colour): The jobs one hue is asked to do, and the ramp that resolves them.

## Browse
- [Discover](https://www.uil4b.com/discover): The community and curated-resource hub.
- [Palette Library](https://www.uil4b.com/discover/palettes): 64 curated palettes, each openable in the Palette Generator.
- [Gradient Library](https://www.uil4b.com/discover/gradients): 100 gradients with stored type, angle and stops.
- [Prompt Library](https://www.uil4b.com/discover/prompts): AI prompts, a free selection for everyone and the full library with Pro.
- [Curated Resources](https://www.uil4b.com/discover/resources): Hand-picked external design and development resources, each linked back to the relevant UIL4B tool.

## More
- [Pricing](https://www.uil4b.com/plans): Free forever for core tools; Pro from $4 USD a month for higher AI limits, advanced colour controls and unwatermarked export.
- [Help Centre](https://www.uil4b.com/help): FAQs and support.
- [Site map](https://www.uil4b.com/sitemap): Every live route, and what is still in the workshop.

## Optional

- Component Designer, Box Shadow Generator and UI Auto-Builder, under /create/components
- AI Image Prompt Generator (/create/ai-prompt) and AI Landing Page Prompts (/create/landing-prompts)
